entities.summary: Julian Jakobsen is a Danish professional ice hockey winger who currently plays as Captain for The Aalborg Pirates of Metal Ligaen (DEN). His sister, Josefine Jakobsen, plays professionally for Djurgårdens IF and has been named Danish Women's Player of the Year twice.
